claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is set for launch as early as April 1, 2026.
Artemis II will send four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
Artemis II is part of the Artemis program.
Artemis II is a test flight.
Artemis IV is planned for 2028.
Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
Artemis II tests the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II crew includes NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch.
Artemis II crew includes Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II mission profile is a 10-day loop around the Moon.
Artemis II will set records for distance and speed beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis III is designed for testing.
Artemis IV intends to land astronauts on the Moon's surface.
Artemis I completed in 2022 an uncrewed lunar flyby.
Artemis I tested the SLS and Orion.
Artemis IV and V are aimed for 2028 and beyond.
Artemis II crew includes the first woman to travel to the Moon's vicinity.
Artemis II crew includes the first person of color to travel to the Moon's vicinity.
Artemis II crew includes the first non-U.S. citizen to travel to the Moon's vicinity.
Artemis Accords date to 2020
